flows:
Navigate to https://www.kidderminster.ac.uk/good-to-know-articles/how-to-apply-for-a-course/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
From fresh page focus, press Tab about twenty times in order.
Look for the first FAQ heading after the breadcrumbs Home, Good to know articles, and How To Apply For a Course.
You can use Shift+Tab to correct an overshoot.
Open it with Tab and Enter.
Verify the answer beginning A next of kin is a relative is visible.
Stay on the public information page.
